verdict_text:
YES

The script verifies identical key sets and bit-identical non-MLP tensors across all three checkpoints before any merging, computes each task vector against the unmodified `base` dict (writing only into the separate `out` dict), uses lambda = 0.4 in float32, and asserts both the 48-merge count and the 160-tensor output before saving to `out/T4/model.safetensors`. The regex `fullmatch` covers exactly the four MLP tensor names per layer and nothing else.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
